svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 400 x 400 mm, 12 mm steel; corners rounded about 10 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Positions from the plate center; the post sits on the center.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four anchor holes 18 mm on a 300 mm square (150 each way).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vent and drain hole 25 mm at the center, under the post:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the galvanizer needs it, and it lets condensation out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Conduit hole 40 mm on the center line, 130 mm toward the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the cabinet side), clear of the post by 64 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld: post square on the plate, 4 mm fillet all round,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: before galvanizing (one weldment with the post).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole; grind weld spatter off the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the post stands square to the plate within 1 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over its height; anchor holes 300 mm apart both ways.
